As designated by its title, the text structurally integrates the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined phenomena) with the *saññojanagocchaka* (the cluster of dyads related to the fetters) and subsequent dyadic classifications (*ādi*) within the complex conditional relational matrices characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral].
